propositions: Core outbound link differ imports and compares vendor Jira link shapes, violating ADR 0035 and epic AC3 requirement for zero adapters.jira imports in core.
Link translation logic is scattered: vendor→canonical at read time in _existing_jira_links, canonical→vendor inline in _diff_links, requiring adapter-side consolidation.

SupportsLinks capability must provide map_remote_links (vendor fields → canonical link set with opaque type passenger) and link_payload_for_relation (relation → vendor type, swap) to move translation to adapter.
ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic, matching local deps against remote links by (opaque_vendor_type, remote_key) pair regardless of inward/outward side.
outbound_differ.py must thread the configured backend's SupportsLinks capability into _diff_links as a new argument.
AST neutrality gate in test_backend_neutrality.py must be extended to enforce zero adapters.jira imports in outbound_links.py and outbound_differ.py.
